methods.label: Expand first
methods.explanation: Expanding gives \(3x-3=9\). Transposing terms gives \(3x=12\), so \(x=4\).
methods.levelReason: The retained route uses only Grade 7 removal of parentheses and transposition.

methods.label: Divide first
methods.explanation: Here \(3\) multiplies the whole expression \(x-1\). Dividing both sides by the nonzero number \(3\) isolates this expression, giving \(x-1=3\); adding \(1\) to both sides gives \(x=4\).
methods.levelReason: Treating the parenthesized expression as a whole allows simple equation solving using division and addition, without expansion.
